text: URL: https://egspec.org/admissions/why-study-here EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Admissions Why Study Here Why Choose EGS Pillay Engineering College? EGS Pillay Engineering College stands as a beacon of academic excellence in Nagapattinam, offering a dynamic learning environment that nurtures innovation, creativity, and holistic development. EGS Pillay Engineering College

EGS Pillay Engineering College Academic Excellence: EGS Pillay Engineering College is known for its strong emphasis on academic excellence, providing students with a rigorous and comprehensive curriculum that prepares them for success in their chosen fields. Industry-Aligned Curriculum: The college offers an industry-aligned curriculum designed in collaboration with leading companies and professionals, ensuring that students acquire the skills and knowledge demanded by the industry.

Experienced Faculty: EGS Pillay Engineering College boasts a team of experienced faculty members who are experts in their respective fields. They provide mentorship, guidance, and support to students throughout their academic journey. State-of-the-Art Facilities: The college is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, including modern laboratories, libraries, and research centers, providing students with access to the latest technology and resources to enhance their learning experience.

Practical Learning Opportunities: EGS Pillay Engineering College emphasizes practical learning, offering students opportunities to apply theoretical knowledge in real-world settings through internships, projects, and industry collaborations. Soft Skill Development: In addition to technical skills, the college focuses on developing students' soft skills such as communication, teamwork, and leadership, essential for their professional growth and success.

Innovation and Entrepreneurship: The college fosters a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship, encouraging students to think creatively, explore new ideas, and develop innovative solutions to real-world problems. Extracurricular Activities: EGS Pillay Engineering College offers a vibrant campus life with a wide range of extracurricular activities, including sports, cultural events, and clubs, providing students with opportunities to explore their interests and talents beyond academics.

Alumni Network: The college has a strong alumni network consisting of successful professionals and entrepreneurs who serve as mentors and role models for current students, offering guidance and support in their career endeavors. Career Opportunities: Graduates of EGS Pillay Engineering College are highly sought after by top companies and organizations, thanks to the college's strong reputation, industry connections, and alumni network, providing excellent career opportunities upon graduation.

Pillay Engineering College, organizes a two-day workshop on “EV Powertrain Design and Simulation with Hands-on Hardware Exposure”

exclusively for third-year EEE students. The workshop aims to provide participants with practical knowledge of electric vehicle (EV) powertrain architecture, design principles, simulation techniques, and hardware implementation . The sessions will introduce students to the major components and operating principles of EV powertrains, including electric motors, power converters, battery systems, motor control, and power management

. Participants will also gain exposure to simulation-based design and understand how theoretical concepts are applied in real-world electric vehicle systems. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/industry-supported-laboratories EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Industry Supported Laboratories Why Industry-Supported Laboratories Are Important 1. Bridge the Gap Between Academia and Industry: Industry-supported labs ensure that students are exposed to real-world tools, technologies, and workflows, reducing the mismatch between academic learning and industry expectations. 2. Access to Latest Technologies:

2. Access to Latest Technologies: These labs are equipped with cutting-edge hardware, software, and platforms provided by industry partners. This keeps students updated with the latest trends, which traditional academic labs may not always offer. 3. Industry-Recognized Certifications: Many companies offer training and certification programs through these labs, allowing students to earn globally recognized credentials that improve career prospects. 4. Internship and Placement Opportunities:

4. Internship and Placement Opportunities: Collaboration with industry improves chances for Internships, Industrial projects, and Direct recruitment. Companies often consider students trained in their supported labs as pre-skilled candidates. 5. Exposure to Real Industry Projects: Students and faculty can work on live projects, case studies, and product development activities directly supported by industry experts. 6. Faculty Development and Up-skilling:

6. Faculty Development and Up-skilling: Faculty members receive training and workshops from industry specialists, which keeps teaching in line with current industry standards. 7. Research and Innovation Support: Industry labs often fund or guide Research initiatives, Student startups, and Innovation challenges and hackathons. This boosts the institution’s research output and visibility. 8. Improved Institutional Reputation:

8. Improved Institutional Reputation: Having industry-supported labs positions the institution as Industry-aligned, Progressive, and Technology-ready. It enhances the credibility of academic programs and attracts better admissions. 9. Supports Outcome-Based Education (OBE): These labs directly contribute to achieving Program Outcomes (POs) and Program Specific Outcomes (PSOs) by providing measurable hands-on learning experiences. Labs & Objectives Oracle Workforce Development Program

Oracle Workforce Development Program To transform business requirements into an operational database To create physical relational database tables to implement a database design To manage a business project that delivers a database design and model for a potential client To create, maintain, and manipulate database objects To prepare for Oracle 10g - SQL and JAVA Programming Networking (CISCO) Laboratory

Networking (CISCO) Laboratory Learn the basic concepts of computer networking and acquire practical notions of protocols with the emphasis on TCP/IP. To receive the internship from networking companies To understand the simulation concepts of wireless and wired networks. Autodesk Design Lab Develop Industry-Ready Design Skills:

Develop Industry-Ready Design Skills: To equip students with practical skills in 3D modeling, drafting, simulation, and visualization using Autodesk tools such as AutoCAD, Fusion 360, Revit, Maya, and Inventor. Promote Industry-Standard Design Practices: To familiarize learners with international design standards, workflows, and best practices widely used in engineering, architecture, and manufacturing industries. Enable Hands-on Learning Through Advanced Tools:

Enable Hands-on Learning Through Advanced Tools: To provide students with hands-on exposure to Autodesk’s professional design and engineering software, enabling them to create accurate technical drawings, models, and prototypes. Enhance Innovation and Creativity: To encourage innovative thinking by allowing students to conceptualize, design, and simulate products or structures in a virtual environment. Altair Centre of Excellence Develop Advanced Simulation and Engineering Analysis Skills:

To equip students with hands-on expertise in CAE, FEA, CFD, MBD, and optimization using Altair’s industry-leading tools. Promote Industry-Standard Engineering Practices: To train learners in industry-validated simulation workflows, ensuring accuracy and reliability. Enable End-to-End Product Development: To help students understand the full digital engineering lifecycle using Altair’s integrated platform. Foster Data-Driven Engineering:

Foster Data-Driven Engineering: To introduce students to AI/ML-enabled design exploration and predictive modeling. Enhance Multidisciplinary Engineering Problem Solving: To enable students to analyze complex systems identifying structures, fluids, thermal behavior, etc. Improve Productivity Through High-Performance Computing: To train students on Altair PBS Works and cloud-based simulation. VMware IT Academy Develop Core Virtualization Skills:

Develop Core Virtualization Skills: To equip students with practical skills in server, desktop, and network virtualization using VMware tools. Enable Cloud Computing Competency: To introduce learners to cloud architectures and management using VMware Cloud Foundation. Promote Data Center Modernization Knowledge: To help students understand modern IT infrastructures including SDDC and virtualized storage. Build High Availability and Disaster Recovery Expertise:

To train students in configuring HA clusters, Fault Tolerance, and Disaster Recovery. Strengthen Skills in Network Virtualization: To educate students on VMware NSX and virtual network management. TRIONE CADD Develop Advanced CAD Modeling Competency: To train students in creating complex 3D models using CATIA and CREO. Strengthen Product Design and Development Skills: To enable learners to understand the complete product lifecycle from design to manufacturing.

Enhance Surface and Solid Modeling Expertise: To build strong capabilities in Solid modeling, Surface modeling, Sheet metal design, and Assembly design. To familiarize students with design standards in automotive and aerospace industries. IoT & Embedded Systems Lab (Enthu Tech) Develop Core Skills in IoT and Embedded Systems: To train students in sensor integration, microcontroller programming, and IoT system development. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/information-technology/program-outcomes EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Information Technology Program Outcomes Program Outcomes (POs) ## PO1 Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems. PO2

PO2 Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. (WK1 to WK4) PO3

PO3 Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. (WK5) PO4

PO4 Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. (WK8). PO5 Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. (WK2 and WK6) PO6

PO6 The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. (WK1, WK5, and WK7). PO7 Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws. (WK9) PO8

PO8 Individual and Collaborative Team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams. PO9 Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences PO10

PO10 Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. PO11

PO11 Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. (WK8) Knowledge and Attitude Profile (WK) Knowledge and Attitude Profile WK1 A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences. WK2

WK4 Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline. WK5 Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole-life cost, re-use of resources, net zero carbon, and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area. WK6

WK8 Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues. WK9 Ethics, inclusive behavior and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes. Other Links

URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/biomedical-engineering EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Biomedical Engineering About

The department of Biomedical Engineering was established in the year 2019. The importance of education lies in translating opportunities into experiences of empowerment, in transcending 'what is' to 'what can be' and transforming limitations into limitless learning. The department aims to bridge the gap between engineering and medical sciences to improve healthcare delivery. With well-qualified and experienced staff, the department continually updates its laboratories with modern facilities

. As per university norms, a semester system is being followed. The department follows the latest EGSPEC Regulation to ensure a comprehensive education. Various seminars and workshops are conducted periodically to enhance learning. The department also fosters associations related to the field, encouraging students to work on mini-projects in their pre-final year to implement their ideas practically

. Faculty members specialize in areas such as Medical Imaging, Biomechanics, Biomaterials, and Medical Instrumentation, preparing students for industry and research. The department maintains strong industry links with renowned organizations, offering value-added and certification courses to enhance student skills.

Vision To achieve excellence in Biomedical engineering education and serve as a valuable resource Centre to the industry and the society. Mission To produce competent Biomedical Engineers through quality education and training. To maintain state-of-the-art learning facilities, enhance the competence of faculty and evolve as a centre of excellence through R & D.

To develop skilled professionals with academic reliability, good communication, attitude towards lifelong learning, ability to be team players. To bridge the gap between the industry and academia with expanding collaboration and partnerships with industry through MOUs, projects, and consultancy fulfilling societal needs.
